verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's own docs describe an agent that resolves issues end-to-end through natural-language and deterministic workflows. It also coordinates specialist agents across multi-step, multi-system workflows, which supports the multi-step troubleshooting half of the story. Nothing in the evidence explicitly shows the agent asking customers clarifying questions or avoiding canned single answers. Missing for 10: documented clarifying-question behavior, explicit multi-turn troubleshooting examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent asks clarifying questions and works through multi-step troubleshooting instead of dumping one canned answer

citations.quote: one agent that resolves issues end-to-end across chat, email, voice and SMS
Lorikeet coordinates a team of specialist agents, with pockets of determinism for regulated steps, to handle multi-party, multi-system workflows end-to-end.
The agent takes action through your APIs and MCP servers inside natural-language and deterministic workflows
balance conversational flexibility with structured logic
